proposal.reason: Main functional change is review/merge automation policy and routing logic: .github/scripts/review_automation.py and maintainer_approval.py add role-based module requirements, command-driven module overrides, invitation withdrawal/reinvite rules, and current-HEAD approval gating; related workflow wiring changes in .github/workflows/review-module.yml, maintainer-approval.yml, and commit-message.yml support that same review workflow behavior.
